description: Validation rules and LeaveRequestService with full workflow lifecycle. Depends on FEAT-001 (LeaveBalanceService, config/leave.php, LeaveRequestException must exist). Independent from FEAT-003 (notifications).
steps: Create app/Rules/Leave/WorkingDaysRule.php implementing Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule. Constructor: `__construct()` — no args at construction; add `setData(array $data): static` to receive full validated data (called by Laravel automatically for rules that implement DataAwareRule — implement Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\DataAwareRule instead and add `public array $data = []; public function setData(array $data): static { $this->data = $data; return $this; }`). Add `public float $calculatedDays = 0.0;` property. In `validate(string $attribute, mixed $value, Closure $fail)`: parse start_date and end_date from $this->data using Carbon::parse(). Use CarbonPeriod::create($start, $end) to iterate each day. Skip days where $day->dayOfWeek is in config('leave.working_week_off_days'). Query Holiday::whereBetween('date', [$start->toDateString(), $end->toDateString()])->pluck('date')->map(fn($d) => Carbon::parse($d)->toDateString()) to get holiday strings. Skip days matching a holiday. Set $this->calculatedDays = count of remaining days. Do NOT call $fail — this rule only corrects the count.

Create app/Rules/Leave/SufficientBalanceRule.php implementing ValidationRule. Constructor: `__construct(private LeaveBalance $balance)`. In validate($attribute, $value, $fail): compute $remaining = $this->balance->remaining. Add `public ?string $warning = null;`. If $remaining < (float)$value: check config('leave.warn_only_insufficient_balance'). If true: set $this->warning = "رصيدك المتبقي ({$remaining} يوم) أقل من المطلوب ({$value} يوم). سيستمر الطلب تحت مسؤوليتك.". If false: call $fail("رصيد الإجازة غير كافٍ. المتبقي: {$remaining} يوم، المطلوب: {$value} يوم.").

Create app/Rules/Leave/NoOverlapRule.php implementing ValidationRule. Constructor: `__construct(private int $employeeId, private string $startDate, private string $endDate, private ?int $excludeRequestId = null)`. In validate($attribute, $value, $fail): use LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes()->overlapping($this->employeeId, $this->startDate, $this->endDate, $this->excludeRequestId)->exists(). If true: $fail('يوجد طلب إجازة آخر للموظف يتداخل مع هذه الفترة.'). Note: pass all date context via constructor so validation is self-contained.

Create app/Rules/Leave/MaxDaysPerRequestRule.php implementing ValidationRule. Constructor: `__construct(private LeaveType $leaveType)`. In validate: if $leaveType->max_days_per_request !== null && (float)$value > $leaveType->max_days_per_request: $fail("الحد الأقصى لهذا النوع من الإجازات هو {$this->leaveType->max_days_per_request} يوم في الطلب الواحد.").

Create app/Rules/Leave/CasualBeforeRegularRule.php implementing ValidationRule. Constructor: `__construct(private Employee $employee, private LeaveType $requestedType, private int $year)`. Add `public ?string $warning = null;`. In validate($attribute, $value, $fail): Only proceed if $requestedType->code === 'regular' AND (float)$value <= 2. Find casual LeaveType: $casualType = LeaveType::where('code', 'casual')->first(). If null, return (no casual type configured). Get balance: $casualBalance = $this->employee->balanceFor($casualType->id, $this->year). If $casualBalance && $casualBalance->remaining > 0 && config('leave.casual_before_regular_warning'): set $this->warning = 'ينبغي استخدام رصيد الإجازة العارضة أولاً قبل الاعتيادية للطلبات التي تبلغ يوم أو يومين.'. Never calls $fail.

Create app/Services/DTO/CreateLeaveRequestResult.php as a readonly class: `readonly class CreateLeaveRequestResult { public function __construct(public readonly LeaveRequest $request, public readonly array $warnings) {} }`.
Create app/Services/LeaveRequestService.php. Constructor: `public function __construct(private LeaveBalanceService $balanceService)`. Register as singleton in AppServiceProvider::register().

Implement `create(array $data, User $createdBy): CreateLeaveRequestResult` in LeaveRequestService: Resolve Employee from $data['employee_id'] (use Employee::withoutGlobalScopes()->findOrFail()). Resolve LeaveType. Run WorkingDaysRule, collect calculatedDays. Override $data['days'] = $workingDaysRule->calculatedDays if > 0. Run NoOverlapRule($employee->id, $data['start_date'], $data['end_date']). Run MaxDaysPerRequestRule($leaveType). Get or create balance: $balance = $balanceService->getOrCreateBalance($employee, $leaveType, now()->year). Run SufficientBalanceRule($balance) and CasualBeforeRegularRule($employee, $leaveType, now()->year). Collect non-null ->warning strings into $warnings[]. Wrap in DB::transaction(): LeaveRequest::create(array_merge($data, ['created_by' => $createdBy->id, 'organization_id' => $employee->organization_id, 'status' => LeaveStatus::DRAFT])). Return new CreateLeaveRequestResult($request, $warnings).

Implement `submit(LeaveRequest $request, User $submittedBy): LeaveRequest` in LeaveRequestService: Guard: if !in_array($request->status, [LeaveStatus::DRAFT, LeaveStatus::RETURNED]) throw LeaveRequestException::invalidTransition($request->status, LeaveStatus::SUBMITTED). DB::transaction(): load employee and leaveType. $balance = $balanceService->getOrCreateBalance($employee, $leaveType, now()->year). Snapshot: $request->balance_entitled = $balance->entitled; $request->balance_used = $balance->used; $request->balance_remaining = $balance->remaining. Load WorkflowConfiguration::where('organization_id', $request->organization_id)->active()->ordered()->get(). If empty: throw new \RuntimeException('لا يوجد مسار اعتماد مُعرَّف لهذه المؤسسة.'). Delete any existing steps (for re-submit after RETURNED). Create LeaveRequestStep for each workflow config: ['leave_request_id' => $request->id, 'step_order' => $wc->step_order, 'stage' => $wc->stage_name, 'status' => StepStatus::PENDING]. Set $request->current_stage = first WorkflowConfiguration->stage_name. $request->status = LeaveStatus::SUBMITTED. $request->save(). Return $request->fresh(['steps']).

Implement `approve(LeaveRequest $request, LeaveRequestStep $step, User $actedBy, ?string $note): LeaveRequest` in LeaveRequestService: Guards: status must be SUBMITTED or IN_REVIEW; step->status must be PENDING; step->stage must equal $request->current_stage — throw LeaveRequestException::invalidTransition() with detail on any guard fail. DB::transaction(): Update step: status=APPROVED, acted_by=$actedBy->id, acted_at=now(), note=$note. Load WorkflowConfiguration for this org + stage_name to get approval_rule. Count total PENDING+APPROVED steps with same stage (step_order) on this request. Count approved steps in this stage. Evaluate $approvalRule->isStageApproved($approvedCount, $totalInStage). If stage approved: mark remaining PENDING steps in this stage as SKIPPED. Find next WorkflowConfiguration (step_order > current, is_active=true, ordered). If next exists: $request->current_stage = $next->stage_name; $request->status = LeaveStatus::IN_REVIEW; create next stage step if not present. If NO next config: $request->status = LeaveStatus::APPROVED; $request->current_stage = null; $request->decided_by = $actedBy->id; if $request->leaveType->deducts_balance: $this->balanceService->deduct($balance, $request->days, $request, $actedBy) (reload $balance from DB inside transaction with lockForUpdate). If stage NOT yet approved: no request status change. $request->save(). Return $request->fresh().

Implement `reject(LeaveRequest $request, LeaveRequestStep $step, User $actedBy, string $reason): LeaveRequest` in LeaveRequestService: Guards: same as approve. DB::transaction(): step->update([status=REJECTED, acted_by, acted_at, note=$reason]). Mark ALL other steps with status=PENDING as SKIPPED via $request->steps()->where('status', StepStatus::PENDING->value)->update(['status' => StepStatus::SKIPPED]). $request->update([status=REJECTED, rejection_reason=$reason, current_stage=null, decided_by=$actedBy->id]). Return $request->fresh().

Implement `return(LeaveRequest $request, LeaveRequestStep $step, User $actedBy, string $note): LeaveRequest` in LeaveRequestService: Guards: status must be SUBMITTED or IN_REVIEW; step->status must be PENDING. DB::transaction(): step->update([status=RETURNED, acted_by, acted_at, note]). Mark all other PENDING steps as SKIPPED. $request->update([status=RETURNED, current_stage=null]). Return $request->fresh(). (Method name 'return' is a PHP reserved word — name the method `returnRequest` instead, matching the plan item.)

Implement `cancel(LeaveRequest $request, User $cancelledBy): LeaveRequest` in LeaveRequestService: Guard: if !$request->status->canBeCancelled() throw LeaveRequestException::invalidTransition($request->status, LeaveStatus::CANCELLED). DB::transaction(): $wasApproved = ($request->status === LeaveStatus::APPROVED). $request->steps()->where('status', StepStatus::PENDING->value)->update(['status' => StepStatus::SKIPPED]). $request->update([status=CANCELLED, current_stage=null]). If $wasApproved AND $request->leaveType->deducts_balance: load balance and call $this->balanceService->refund($balance, $request->days, $request, $cancelledBy). Return $request->fresh().
acceptance_criteria: WorkingDaysRule correctly counts only Mon-Thu working days and excludes holidays from the holidays table
SufficientBalanceRule sets ->warning (not fail) when warn_only=true; calls $fail when warn_only=false
NoOverlapRule blocks when an active overlapping request exists; passes when only rejected/cancelled overlap
MaxDaysPerRequestRule blocks when days > max_days_per_request on the LeaveType
CasualBeforeRegularRule sets ->warning for 1-2 day regular request when casual balance exists
create() returns CreateLeaveRequestResult with DRAFT request and warnings array
submit() creates LeaveRequestStep rows matching WorkflowConfiguration and snapshots balance columns
approve() with ANY rule advances to next stage after single approval
approve() with ALL rule waits until all steps in stage are approved before advancing
approve() on final stage sets status=APPROVED and calls balanceService->deduct() when deducts_balance=true
reject() sets status=REJECTED and marks all pending steps as SKIPPED
returnRequest() sets status=RETURNED and marks all pending steps as SKIPPED
cancel() on non-cancellable status throws LeaveRequestException
cancel() on previously-APPROVED request calls balanceService->refund()
